newsitem.title: UK: C.E. Heath completes Lloyds New York sale.
newsitem.headline: C.E. Heath completes Lloyds New York sale.

text.p: C.E. Heath Plc on Friday said it completed the sale of its 55.98 percent interest in Lloyds New York Insurance Co to Stirling Cooke North America Holdings Ltd, following receipt of regulatory approval.
Health and its Heath Investments Inc subsidiary sold the interest in Lloyds New York for about $4.64 million, including a previous deposit but excluding an element of deferred consideration.

"We are pleased to have completed the sale of Lloyds of New York and thus finalised our strategy of withdrawing from underwriting activities," Heath chief executive John Mackenzie Green said in a statement. "Heath is now fully focused on core insurance broking operations."
